handoff_note: Approved (2026-10-25, see Notes): build with the proposed sources. Proposal (claude-loop3, 2026-10-25): words and frequencies counted from Mozilla Common Voice sentence text (CC0, github.com/common-voice/common-voice server/data/<lang>): es 74 MB of sentences; keep about 50,000 words seen more than a few times; typing without accents matches by stripping them (cancion → canción). Pack about 1–2 MB (the English pack is 3.3 MB). Not usable: hermitdave FrequencyWords and wordfreq (their word data is CC-BY-SA 4.0), Leipzig corpora (non-commercial).
